# Power Rogers

> Chicago-based trial law firm specializing in personal injury, medical malpractice, and wrongful death cases with a team of experienced attorneys.

Power Rogers is a prominent personal injury and medical malpractice law firm based in Chicago with multiple award-winning trial lawyers. The firm has recovered hundreds of millions in settlements and verdicts for clients across Illinois and maintains a strong reputation in the legal community.
